items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 8 Jan (UK only). Fresh off the back of his Essential New Tune, Changes, Mella Dee makes a return to the Hot Mix. Also, there's new music from the likes of Elvis Guetta, Sideral, Volkoder, Chris Stassy x IPC, CamelPhat, JAMIIE x Alan DIxon, Notre Dame, Alex Wann x David Mackay, Rooléh and more. Produced by We Are Grape for BBC Radio 1.
items.title: Mella Dee

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 1 Jan (UK only). We catch up with Adam Beyer, the visionary behind Drumcode, as the influential label celebrates three decades at the forefront of techno. Adam hand-picks three essential records and delivers a special 30-minute Hot Mix. There’s also music from Mella Dee, Luch & Jamek Ortega, Carlita, Joseph Capriati, Ruze, Brunello, Adam Ten and Tim Green. Plus, Pete pays tribute to techno pioneer Juan Atkins, who sadly passed away at the end of October. Produced by We Are Grape for BBC Radio 1.
items.title: Adam Beyer

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 25 Dec (UK only). Pete looks back at the sounds, stories and standout moments shaping global dance music over the past month. He rewinds all of his Essential New Tunes from October so far, unveiling a brand new addition along the way. Goom Gum deliver a spooky Hot Mix, while Danny Howard, Sarah Story and Jamie Jones share their October favourites. Plus, fresh music from MK, Beave, Joe Rolét & Skepta, Chiquito, Mella Dee, Brunello, Emanuel Satie, George FitzGerald and more. Produced by We Are Grape for BBC Radio 1.
items.title: The Month in Dance: October 2026

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 18 Dec (UK only). In celebration of ADE, Pete has a guest Club Heat Mix from rising star AAT featuring all unreleased music and he rewinds Dutch royalty ANOTR's Hot Mix from when they covered the show back in August. Plus, there's new music from the likes of The Magician & JØRD, Julian Fjima, Bontan, BICEP, DESIREE, Hilel Lev, Arodes and Jimi Jules & Tri/xon. Produced by We Are Grape for BBC Radio 1.
items.title: All Gone Dutch - AAT & ANOTR

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 11 Dec (UK only). Josh Baker joins Pete to talk about his mammoth 3-hour Essential Mix, recorded live at the closing party of his Ibiza residency. Plus, Cuba-born Blue Marlin Ibiza resident Khenya guest stars in the Hot Mix. There's also new music from the likes of TSHA, Prospa x KETTAMA, Liva K, ANOTR, Steve Lawler, Deer Jade, TOMORA, Joey London Style, Mochakk, Ammo Avenue, Syreeta x DJ Minx and more. Produced by We Are Grape for BBC Radio 1.
items.title: Josh Baker and Khenya

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 4 Dec (UK only). Italian DJ and producer Silvie Loto rounds off a summer of standout shows, including at DC-10 with the Solid Grooves crew, as she steps into Pete’s Club Heat Mix. Plus, Josh Gigante returns to the Hot Mix decks with a session dedicated entirely to his own productions. And there’s plenty of fresh music to get stuck into, with new cuts from Gorgon City, D.O.D, Franky Rizardo, Chris Lorenzo, Mita Gami, Najeh, Andrea Oliva, Patrick Topping, Dam Swindle and more. Produced by We Are Grape for BBC Radio 1.
items.title: Silvie Loto and Josh Gigante

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 27 Nov (UK only). Your essential guide to the very best in dance and electronic music from the summer of 26! Miss Monique, Carl Cox, Bedouin, Deer Jade, L.P. Giobbi, Cam Stockman, Sidney Charles, Patrick Topping, Clapton, Emma 2000, Major League DJz, Rossi, Alex Wann, DJ Tennis and Colyn all appear. Plus Pete crowns his Essential New Tune of the summer, then hands out a new Essential New Tune honour to Josh Baker, who's had a huge summer. Pete plays out the show with a Sounds of the Summer Hot Mix! Produced by We Are Grape for BBC Radio 1.
items.title: The Summer in Dance - 2026

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 20 Nov (UK only). Pete recaps his Essential New Tunes for September before unveiling a new one. There's selections from some of the Radio 1 Dance Family and HotLap debut in the Hot Mix. Produced by We Are Grape for BBC Radio 1.
items.title: The Month in Dance: September 2026
